diagnosis: The view checks request.user.has_perm('dossiers.view_classifieddossier') without passing the dossier instance to has_perm. In django-guardian, omitting the object checks standard Django model-level permissions rather than object-level permissions, allowing any staff member with model-wide view rights to download classified dossiers restricted to other users.
